set.acceptance_criteria: worklog init writes the scripts only under bin/wiki-ticket. A stock leftover at bin/<name> is removed. A foreign file in bin/ is left in place. bin/ is removed only when it is empty.
set.body: Init was copying the worklog CLI into bin/ next to whatever scripts the repo already kept there. Those names (fold.py, ulid.py, ia.py, and the rest) collided with the repo's own tools and showed up on PATH. The scripts now install under bin/wiki-ticket/, and the command is bin/wiki-ticket/worklog. Upgrade removes a leftover bin/<name> only when it is still the stock 0.24.12 script.
set.title: Install the CLI under bin/wiki-ticket
